summary_md: **HOPE. ([@rlaope](https://x.com/rlaope/status/2115703918412112051))** demos **oh-my-hermes (OMH)**, a skills and coding-intelligence package for the Hermes Agent, turning a single `/dag-ulw` request into a graph of parallel lanes with a separate verification node that catches and repairs a fault before reporting success; each node can use its own model and reasoning effort, wrapped in an understand→plan→execute→verify→learn workflow and a TUI lane tree ([rlaope/oh-my-hermes](https://github.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes)).
